disabled.$description: A disabled button (WCAG does not require contrast for disabled elements).

unavailable.$description: A button whose feature does not exist yet ('Coming later'): stays readable but weaker than a normal one.

context-plate.$description: Fill of a pale context entry in the capture window: the message plate fill with this opacity. Only the fill: the text keeps its normal color, so the text contrast is computed from the existing pairs (the fill lies between the paper and the plate).

panel-edge.$description: A thin light outline of the floating capture panel: a border in the primary text color with this opacity (a pseudo-element of the panel). It separates the panel from dark windows behind it; on light desktops the fill and the shadow are enough.

scrim.$description: The backdrop of a modal window: a fill in the window background color with this opacity. The main window behind the dialog stays distinguishable but recedes.
